pairs: Then the Lord said to Abram:
et veni in terram quam monstrabo tibi.
and come into the land that I will show you.
And I will make of you a great nation,
I will bless those who bless you,
and curse those who curse you,
atque in te benedicentur universæ cognationes terræ.
and in you all the families of the earth will be blessed.”
Egressus est itaque Abram sicut præceperat ei Dominus,
And so Abram departed just as the Lord had instructed him,
septuaginta quinque annorum erat Abram cum egrederetur de Haran.
Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.
And he took his wife Sarai,
and Lot, the son of his brother,
and all the substance which they had come to possess,
et animas quas fecerant in Haran:
and the lives which they had acquired in Haran,
et egressi sunt ut irent in terram Chanaan.
and they departed in order to go to the land of Canaan.
And when they arrived in it,
pertransivit Abram terram usque ad locum Sichem,
Abram passed through the land even to the place of Shechem,
as far as the famous steep valley.
Chananæus autem tunc erat in terra.
Now at that time, the Canaanite was in the land.
Then the Lord appeared to Abram,
“To your offspring, I will give this land.”
And there he built an altar to the Lord,
And passing on from there to a mountain,
which was opposite the east of Bethel,
He also built an altar there to the Lord,
and he called upon his name.
going out and continuing further on, toward the south.
Facta est autem fames in terra:
But a famine occurred in the land.
For famine prevailed over the land.
Cumque prope esset ut ingrederetur Ægyptum,
And when he was close to entering Egypt,
he said to his wife Sarai:
“I know you to be a beautiful woman.
et quod cum viderint te Ægyptii,
And when the Egyptians see you,
And they will put me to death,
obsecro te, quod soror mea sis:
I beg you to say that you are my sister,
ut bene sit mihi propter te,
so that it may be well with me because of you,
et vivat anima mea ob gratiam tui.
and so that my soul may live by your favor.”
Cum itaque ingressus esset Abram Ægyptum,
And so, when Abram had arrived in Egypt,
viderunt Ægyptii mulierem quod esset pulchra nimis.
the Egyptians saw that the woman was exceedingly beautiful.
And the princes reported it to Pharaoh,
and they praised her to him.
et sublata est mulier in domum Pharaonis.
And the woman was inducted into the house of Pharaoh.
Abram vero bene usi sunt propter illam:
In truth, they treated Abram well because of her.
fueruntque ei oves et boves et asini,
And he had sheep and oxen and male donkeys, and men servants,
Flagellavit autem Dominus Pharaonem plagis maximis,
and his house with great wounds because of Sarai,
Quidnam est hoc quod fecisti mihi?
“What is this that you have done to me?
quare non indicasti quod uxor tua esset?
Why did you not tell me she was your wife?
quam ob causam dixisti esse sororem tuam,
For what reason did you claim her to be your sister,
ut tollerem eam mihi in uxorem?
so that I would take her to me as a wife?
And Pharaoh instructed his men about Abram.
et deduxerunt eum, et uxorem illius, et omnia quæ habebat.
And they led him away with his wife and all that he had.
